exposure: symptomatic women with abnormal anorectal studies
asymptomatic women with abnormal anorectal studies
primary obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) repair
asymptomatic women with normal anorectal studies
outcome: abnormal anorectal study results (endo anal ultrasound and anal manometry)
cohort: 1348 women who attended perineal clinic after primary OASI repair
finding: Most women were asymptomatic 6 months following primary OASI repair, but the majority of these had at least one abnormal anorectal study result, suggesting a risk of future faecal incontinence.
